 CBS News Videos Updated Sat, November 21, 2026 at 1:10 AM UTC Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. A concert by rap artist OsamaSon at a New York City venue ended in a stampede that injured four people after an invitation to head to the merchandise booth for an exclusive gift. Tom Hanson has more.
